title: Question 8
passage:
Where can I refill my water bottle after the gates open?
A. The bottle holds about a liter. B. The gates open at nine. C. There's a fountain behind the information booth.
passageZh:
入口開放後，我可以在哪裡裝水？
A. 這個水瓶大約裝得下一公升。 B. 入口九點開放。 C. 服務台後方有飲水機。
